title: Add cancellation for person-analysis stages
description: Let users see person-stage phase progress and cancel tracking, identity, or attribute work. Cancellation must stop queued tasks, cooperatively stop running work at safe checkpoints, report a cancelled state, and leave the last published artifacts unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: The person-stage UI shows the active step and progress and offers a cancel action; cancellation stops queued work and active tasks at safe checkpoints, cleans staging data, preserves prior published artifacts, and reports cancellation distinctly from failure.
close_reason: Implemented person-stage cancellation and progress controls for tracking, identities/face embeddings, and attributes; publication boundaries are protected.

title: Implement bounded worker pools for person workflows
description: Implement the staged design in docs/person-workflow-worker-pool-plan.md: bounded scheduling, scene-parallel tracking, parallel identity preparation with deterministic global clustering, and structured progress reporting. Resolve model concurrency and rollout gates before raising inference concurrency. This issue tracks implementation work after the plan is reviewed.
acceptance_criteria: Person workflow subtasks run under bounded configurable worker limits; outputs and review/revision guarantees remain deterministic; progress survives refresh/reconnect and reports task counts; representative benchmarks show a repeatable speedup before concurrency above one is enabled by default.
close_reason: Implemented bounded person-stage and task pools, deterministic scene/identity aggregation, structured progress, and conservative concurrency defaults; validation passed.

title: Document a worker-pool plan for person analysis
description: Create a repository design document for bounded job/worker-pool execution across person tracking, identity embedding, clustering, and attribute extraction, including progress reporting, state safety, rollout, and validation.
acceptance_criteria: A concrete implementation plan is documented against the current backend and frontend architecture, with rollout phases and measurable acceptance criteria.
close_reason: Documented the implementation plan in docs/person-workflow-worker-pool-plan.md.
